properties.bedrock_formation: Grampian Group Metasedimentary Complex (Neoproterozoic Psammite and Semipelite) intruded by Cairngorm Granite plutons
properties.superficial_deposits: Glacial till, hummocky moraine deposits, and alluvial gravel terraces derived from Spey Valley glaciation
properties.soil_profile: Humic podzols and peaty gleys over permeable fluvioglacial coarse sand and gravel, exhibiting natural drainage towards the Strathspey floodplain
properties.hydrogeology: Unconfined shallow upland aquifers feeding localized peat drainage runs and burn tributaries

properties.typology: Highland Agricultural Farmstead and Modern Livestock Barn Complex

structures.facade_material: Corrugated fiber cement profile roofing with translucent skylight panels, treated timber cladding, and concrete dwarf wall foundations
structures.structural_form: Steel portal-frame clear-span barn with low-pitch dual-pitched roof and flanking lean-to extensions

structures.facade_material: Random-rubble Cairngorm granite and metamorphic fieldstone masonry, lime mortar pointing, Scottish slate gabled roof with timber rafters
structures.structural_form: Linear traditional Highland vernacular farm cottage and attached byre

structures.facade_material: Oxidized corrugated iron/metal sheeting over timber post-and-beam frame

civil_infrastructure.access_roads: Compacted crushed granite aggregate and exposed glacial gravel farm tracks with grass center-strips and soft verge runoffs
civil_infrastructure.yard_pavement: Packed earth, gravel wash, and weathered concrete apron pads

properties.biome: Caledonian Highland Moorland and Native Woodland Transition
properties.phenology: Late summer to early autumn transitional palette with deep conifer greens, bronze bracken patches, and golden-green meadow turf

properties.ambient_light: Warm low-angle amber sunlight casting long raking cast shadows eastward across the rolling terrain, with soft ultramarine-tinted skylight filling shadowed facets
properties.atmospheric_scattering: Highland Rayleigh scattering with slight orographic mist and golden particulate suspension over the Spey basin
